ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (24) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Bondarev's «В поте лица снеси хлеб твой» (V pote litsa snesi khleb tvoy, Genesis 3:19) is Church Slavonic and is rendered literally in a slightly archaic register (D0002). The source prints the Ezekiel reference in the Talmud passage as «Иезекииль 22, 27» (Iezekiil' 22, 27); the verse is Ezekiel 27:29, which the English gives.
Source observation: [11] Bible reference printed «(Иезекииль 22, 27)»; the quoted verse is Ezekiel 27:29 (Synodal «И сойдут с кораблей своих все гребцы…»). Corrected in the English.
